name: _transitions.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_transitions.scss — page-transition machinery: the fade/slide-*
//  enter/leave class pairs, the global reduced-motion override (both the
//  html.reduced-motion class and the media-query path), and the
//  #view-outlet cross-fade driven by App._flipToView().
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.fade-enter,
.fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}
// ── Page transitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// All use mode="out-in" in App.vue

// Fade
.fade-enter-active,
.fade-leave-active {
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}
.fade-enter-from,
.fade-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
}

// Slide left: new page enters from right
.slide-left-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
}
.slide-left-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-left-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(48));
}
.slide-left-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(-32));
}

// Slide right: new page enters from left
.slide-right-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
}
.slide-right-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-right-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(-48));
}
.slide-right-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(to-rem(32));
}

// Slide up: new page enters from bottom
.slide-up-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.35s ease,
    transform 0.35s ease;
}
.slide-up-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-up-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(48));
}
.slide-up-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(-24));
}

// Slide down: when leaving About/Legal
.slide-down-enter-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
}
.slide-down-leave-active {
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s ease;
}
.slide-down-enter-from {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(-32));
}
.slide-down-leave-to {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(to-rem(32));
}

// ── Global Reduced Motion Override ─────────────────────────────────────────
html.reduced-motion,
html.reduced-motion *,
html.reduced-motion *::before,
html.reduced-motion *::after {
  animation-duration: 0.001ms;
  animation-iteration-count: 1;
  transition-duration: 0.001ms;
  transition-delay: 0.001ms;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms;
    animation-iteration-count: 1;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms;
    transition-delay: 0.001ms;
  }
}

// ── 3D Book Page Flip Transition ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// ── Page cross-fade transition ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// Outgoing view fades to opacity 0 (350ms), then incoming view fades in.
// Driven by JS in App._flipToView(); no direction logic needed.
#view-outlet > * {
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.page-fade-out {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

// Incoming view starts invisible; JS removes this class after a reflow
// so the CSS transition drives the fade-in automatically.
.page-fade-in {
  opacity: 0;
}
